ValidationRule.description: Revenue per employee must be sane (log-scaled), founding date must not be in the future and young companies (<2y) cannot report >1B revenue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Founded_On__c)), Founded_On__c > TODAY()), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Founded_On__c)), TODAY() - Founded_On__c < 730, NULLVALUE(AnnualRevenue, 0) > 1000000000), AND(NULLVALUE(NumberOfEmployees, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(AnnualRevenue, 0) > 0, ABS(LOG(AnnualRevenue / NumberOfEmployees) - 5) > 4) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Founding date, employees and revenue are not plausible together.
